description: Searches the PeerPush product catalog with a natural language query and semantic matching, plus optional structured filters for pricing, platform, audience, and use case. Relevant when the user wants a software product, tool, app, or service recommended for a specific need (e.g. "email API for transactional emails"). Returns products ranked by relevance and community engagement.

category.description: Filter by category name or slug (e.g. "ai", "developer-tools", "productivity")

platforms.description: Filter by platform: Web, Api, Desktop, Mcp, Cli, Mobile

pricingType.description: Filter by pricing: Free, Freemium, Subscription, OneTime, Paid

query.description: What the user is looking for in natural language (e.g. "email API for transactional emails", "project management for small teams")

useCase.description: Filter by use case (e.g. "Code Development", "Email Campaigns", "Analytics & Reporting")

name: peerpush_find_product
title: Find Products
